West Bengal Cabinet Approves Closure of 250 Private Madrasas

The West Bengal Cabinet has approved the closure of 250 private madrasas. The decision was made due to a lack of students and inadequate infrastructure in these institutions. The cabinet also cleared the recruitment of 1.51 lakh personnel for government positions.
